body_html:
Carve out a quieter, more focused workstation without touching the floor plan. This 30" PET felt privacy screen from Global Furniture Group clamps onto any 1" worksurface to absorb sound and block visual distraction, and its soft, tackable surface doubles as a spot to pin the notes and ideas that keep work moving. Made in Canada from 50% post-recycled polyester fiber, it is an easy, sustainable upgrade for open-plan offices and shared institutional spaces.

Features

  • Sound-absorbing PET felt that softens noise across open-plan and shared workstations
  • Tackable surface for pinning photos, notes and reminders
  • Tool-free clamp mounting for 1" worksurfaces — installs above the desk as a privacy screen or below as a modesty panel
  • 50% post-recycled polyester fiber; 100% recyclable and non-toxic
  • Nine felt finishes: Black, Brick, Denim, Graphite, Harvest, Mist, Pewter, Shamrock and White
  • Tested to meet ANSI/BIFMA standards and backed by Global's Limited Lifetime Warranty, with five years on textiles and electrical components

Specifications

Overall dimensions are 30"W x 3/8"D x 12-1/2"H. Clamps are designed for 1" worksurfaces only. Model PT9PP3013-1, manufactured in Canada by Global Furniture Group.
